//: Race-tile cameras (P1-R05), format jj.framing.v1. The chase presets, first person and its mirror are seeded from the design POC's framing (art/ui/poc/shared/framing.json, P1-U05.2, R98) and are TUNE values until the owner accepts the POC at G-DESIGN. Distances in metres from the car's origin (on the ground between the axles). `rig` holds the host's own tuning: the spring that follows the chase point, speed-scaled look-ahead, the pull-in when a barrier or building hides the car, the first-person comfort limits and speed FOV kick. `byCount` is the host's default distance by the number of players on screen (mid at every count, as the POC frames it, until playtests pick per count); each player may override it for their tile. The first-person eye sits further forward than the POC's (1.05 m, not 0.45 m) because the baked Cruz Missile's bonnet is higher than the POC car's: at 0.45 m it filled 40 % of the tile. `reverse` is the reversing camera (br-dim.4): once the car has moved backwards faster than `enterMps` for `enterHoldS` the chase swings round over `blendS` to look the way it travels, and swings back once it has gone forward faster than `exitMps` for `exitHoldS` (the holds and thresholds are the hysteresis, so a brief reverse tap never flips it; first person never swings, its mirror is the toggle for looking back). `loop` is the loop framing (br-xlvx.6, br-8h3u.2): once the car is `enterUpM` above the road inside a loop's footprint (widened by `marginM`) the chase holds the loop's heading and eases in (time constant `easeInS`) to a point `towardAxis` of the way from the car to the loop's axis, `backM` back along the loop and `upM` up, aimed `lookUpM` over the car, so it sees the car from inside the loop even upside down at the top; it eases back out over `easeOutS` after the exit. No cut, no roll: up stays world-up (owner, 2026-10-24, amending R125's loop rule). Nothing here caps anything.

overview.//: The Derby Overview (P1-R11, master 6.4, R22/R107; web/host/src/camera/overview/rig.ts), seeded from the accepted POC rig (art/ui/poc/shared/framing.json overview, P1-U05.4). Fixed pitch and heading. It frames each car now and lookAheadS ahead plus marginM, on critically damped springs (smooth times s, speed limits m/s; maxZoomOutMps lets the frame open fast enough that a car never leaves it), zooming out quicker than in, with where a car is heading stopped at the bowl's lip, never framing more than the whole bowl (its lip plus lipMarginM) or less than minFrameM of ground. The POC's fixed 120-165 m frame was for its fixed bowl; the game's arena scales with the car count (P1-M10), so the frame follows the cars down to minFrameM. carHeightTarget is the TV profile's median car height as a share of the gameplay frame's height (R22 initial target); padM pads each car for the unused-ground metric; ringM sizes the identity ring under each car; transitionMs is the Grid/Overview switch; spreadOfArena: when the cars want more than this share of the whole-arena frame (a car out of the bowl; at high N the whole arena is the normal frame) or read under the target for a second, the Overview offers the Grid.
